사도행전 28:1.content: And when they were escaped, then they knew that the island was called Melita.

사도행전 28:2.content: And the barbarous people shewed us no little kindness: for they kindled a fire, and received us every one, because of the present rain, and because of the cold.

사도행전 28:3.content: And when Paul had gathered a bundle of sticks, and laid them on the fire, there came a viper out of the heat, and fastened on his hand.

사도행전 28:4.content: And when the barbarians saw the venomous beast hang on his hand, they said among themselves, No doubt this man is a murderer, whom, though he hath escaped the sea, yet vengeance suffereth not to live.

사도행전 28:5.content: And he shook off the beast into the fire, and felt no harm.

사도행전 28:6.content: Howbeit they looked when he should have swollen, or fallen down dead suddenly: but after they had looked a great while, and saw no harm come to him, they changed their minds, and said that he was a god.

사도행전 28:7.content: In the same quarters were possessions of the chief man of the island, whose name was Publius; who received us, and lodged us three days courteously.

사도행전 28:8.content: And it came to pass, that the father of Publius lay sick of a fever and of a bloody flux: to whom Paul entered in, and prayed, and laid his hands on him, and healed him.

사도행전 28:9.content: So when this was done, others also, which had diseases in the island, came, and were healed:

사도행전 28:10.content: Who also honoured us with many honours; and when we departed, they laded us with such things as were necessary.

사도행전 28:11.content: And after three months we departed in a ship of Alexandria, which had wintered in the isle, whose sign was Castor and Pollux.

사도행전 28:12.content: And landing at Syracuse, we tarried there three days.

사도행전 28:13.content: And from thence we fetched a compass, and came to Rhegium: and after one day the south wind blew, and we came the next day to Puteoli:

사도행전 28:14.content: Where we found brethren, and were desired to tarry with them seven days: and so we went toward Rome.

사도행전 28:15.content: And from thence, when the brethren heard of us, they came to meet us as far as Appii forum, and The three taverns: whom when Paul saw, he thanked God, and took courage.

사도행전 28:16.content: And when we came to Rome, the centurion delivered the prisoners to the captain of the guard: but Paul was suffered to dwell by himself with a soldier that kept him.

사도행전 28:17.content: And it came to pass, that after three days Paul called the chief of the Jews together: and when they were come together, he said unto them, Men and brethren, though I have committed nothing against the people, or customs of our fathers, yet was I delivered prisoner from Jerusalem into the hands of the Romans.

사도행전 28:18.content: Who, when they had examined me, would have let me go, because there was no cause of death in me.

사도행전 28:19.content: But when the Jews spake against it, I was constrained to appeal unto Cesar; not that I had ought to accuse my nation of.

사도행전 28:20.content: For this cause therefore have I called for you, to see you, and to speak with you: because that for the hope of Israel I am bound with this chain.

사도행전 28:21.content: And they said unto him, We neither received letters out of Judea concerning thee, neither any of the brethren that came shewed or spake any harm of thee.

사도행전 28:22.content: But we desire to hear of thee what thou thinkest: for as concerning this sect, we know that every where it is spoken against.

사도행전 28:23.content: And when they had appointed him a day, there came many to him into his lodging; to whom he expounded and testified the kingdom of God, persuading them concerning Jesus, both out of the law of Moses, and out of the prophets, from morning till evening.

사도행전 28:24.content: And some believed the things which were spoken, and some believed not.

사도행전 28:25.content: And when they agreed not among themselves, they departed, after that Paul had spoken one word, Well spake the Holy Ghost by Esaias the prophet unto our fathers,

사도행전 28:26.content: Saying, Go unto this people, and say, Hearing ye shall hear, and shall not understand; and seeing ye shall see, and not perceive:

사도행전 28:27.content: For the heart of this people is waxed gross, and their ears are dull of hearing, and their eyes have they closed; lest they should see with their eyes, and hear with their ears, and understand with their heart, and should be converted, and I should heal them.

사도행전 28:28.content: Be it known therefore unto you, that the salvation of God is sent unto the Gentiles, and that they will hear it.

사도행전 28:29.content: And when he had said these words, the Jews departed, and had great reasoning among themselves.

사도행전 28:30.content: And Paul dwelt two whole years in his own hired house, and received all that came in unto him,

사도행전 28:31.content: Preaching the kingdom of God, and teaching those things which concern the Lord Jesus Christ, with all confidence, no man forbidding him.
